final_message:
I made two changes to fix the CI failures. I haven't run anything, because commands needing approval are denied in this session. Please re-run CI to confirm.

- **Unit test failure:** `test/adapters.test.ts` still expected the `schema-version` header to be `"3"`. I changed it to `"4"` to match the schema bump.
- **ARCH-4 failures:** `analytics-ingest` and `billing-service` still require `placedAt` and `totalCents`, so the straight rename breaks them. Those repos are read-only for me. Instead, `OrderPlaced` now carries both name pairs, `createdAt`/`amountCents` and the old `placedAt`/`totalCents`. The old two are marked `@deprecated` in `src/core/events.ts`, and `test/app.test.ts` expects all four.

This means the event isn't fully renamed yet. Once those two teams read the new names, delete the two deprecated fields and their lines in the test. If you'd rather ship the clean rename and have those teams update first, say so and I'll revert the dual fields.
ticket_text: Update the OrderPlaced event by changing totalCents to amountCents and placedAt to createdAt; this brings its naming in line with the Payments and Customer APIs.
